vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: it-risk-assessment-tool
Version: 1.2.0

The IT Risk Assessment Tool is a legitimate security assessment skill that interacts with a documented API at portal.toolweb.in. It functions by gathering user-provided maturity levels for various security controls and sending them via curl to the service to generate a risk report. The skill requires a user-provided TOOLWEB_API_KEY and does not exhibit any signs of unauthorized data exfiltration, malicious code execution, or prompt injection attacks.

llm.summary: The skill's declared purpose (IT risk assessment) matches its instructions and requirements: it asks for one service API key and uses curl to POST user-provided control ratings to portal.toolweb.in — nothing in the package contradicts that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, required binary (curl), required env var (TOOLWEB_API_KEY), and the documented API endpoint all align with an external SaaS that performs IT risk assessments. The requested assets are proportional to the stated functionality.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to collect control maturity inputs from the user and POST them to https://portal.toolweb.in/apis/security/it-risk-assessment using X-API-Key: $TOOLWEB_API_KEY. This is consistent with the tool's purpose, but it does transmit user-provided assessment data (and any values the user types) to an external service — users should be aware and avoid including unrelated secrets or highly sensitive telemetry in those inputs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files — instruction-only. No downloads or archive extraction. Requiring curl is reasonable for making the described HTTP request.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single API key (TOOLWEB_API_KEY) is required and is used as the primary credential in the documented curl request. That is proportionate for a SaaS API integration; no unrelated credentials or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable. It does not request persistent system-wide configuration or modify other skills. Autonomous invocation is allowed by platform default but not unusual; nothing in the skill requests elevated or permanent privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent with its stated purpose, but it sends user-entered assessment data to portal.toolweb.in using the provided TOOLWEB_API_KEY. Before installing or using it: (1) verify you trust portal.toolweb.in and the API key issuer; (2) never paste unrelated secrets, credentials, logs, or PII into the assessment inputs; (3) review the vendor's privacy and data retention policies for the API; and (4) consider testing with non-sensitive/demo data first to confirm results and behavior. If you need on-prem or offline processing, this skill is not suitable as-is.
